commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update customer reverse-ETL action
examples: pm simplesat create or update customer apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new customer or updates the existing one matched by external_id/email; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update response reverse-ETL action
examples: pm simplesat create or update response apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new survey response (or updates one matched by the API's own dedup rule) including its nested answers/customer/ticket/team_members sub-objects; commonly used to import or backfill historical survey data with an explicit created timestamp
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: create or update team member apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the create or update team member reverse-ETL action
examples: pm simplesat create or update team member apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new team member or updates the existing one matched by external_id/email; low-risk external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the send survey email reverse-ETL action
examples: pm simplesat send survey email apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: sends a live survey invitation email to the named customer's real inbox; each call generates one outbound email delivery, not a reversible data mutation
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
commands.notes: named_dependency=engine.reverse_etl_scalar_flag_contract: the reverse-ETL command surface cannot faithfully expose this action's required object or array record fields as scalar flags

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update answer reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: mutates an existing survey answer's recorded choice/comment/follow-up fields; changes the customer-submitted response data an already-collected survey answer represents
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update customer reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: mutates an existing customer's profile fields by id; overwrites tags/custom_attributes wholesale with the submitted value
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update response reverse-ETL action
commands.risk: mutates an existing survey response's tags/answers/team_members by id; overwrites the identified response's recorded data
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
